thread:
alex: Paging handoff — saw an opsbot pager for embeddings-db replication lag in us-west around 03:02. I handled the first glance, but need to hand over primary to @sana for the next hour while I finish a customer postmortem draft.
opsbot: PAGER: embeddings-db-replication-lag (severity: P2) — 5 replicas behind primary, replication lag peaked at 18s, error rate spiked 0.8% during window.
sana: Thanks @alex — I'm taking primary. Quick status? is traffic impacted?
alex: Short summary: replication lag started at 03:02 after a small node restart during autoscaler churn. KV write tail increased which caused the follower queued apply backlog. No full failovers. Observed downstream: ~5% increase in embed generation p95 and ~0.2% requests got retried at the client side. Customer-facing impact: minimal, no data loss.
sana: Ok — I'm on it. Steps I'll take: 1) confirm followers are catching up, 2) pause autoscaler from scaling down for 10m, 3) increase replica apply workers on the primary if needed.
lee: Quick note — running the quick catchup script helped last time: `scripts/replica_catchup.sh --region=us-west --limit=1000`. Leave me as secondary for escalation.
alex: Adding runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-replication|embeddings replication runbook>. Relevant excerpt: ```if replication_lag > 15s for >5m: escalate to DB team and increase apply_worker_count to +50%```
sana: I ran `kubectl get pods -n embeddings-usw` — two follower pods show `CrashLoopBackOff` earlier, both restarted and are now Running. Followers' replay lag is at ~3s and trending down.
lee: Good. I will stand by for DB escalation if lag plateaus >10s in next 10m. Also setting a brief notification to product-support: `@support-team heads-up: small p95 latency bump observed for embeddings in US-W`, no action required yet.
sana: Paused scale-down on the embeddings node pool for 12m (k8s annotation `autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-disabled=true`). Also bumped apply workers via `env override` on primary to +30% for now.
alex: Thanks. Coverage note: I'm handing primary to @sana until 04:10. @lee you're secondary. If anything escalates, page DB team and ping me.
sana: Current status (03:07): followers caught up to 2s, latency returning to normal. Will monitor until 04:10 and then hand back to @alex. Next steps: keep scale-down paused for another 5m, revert apply_worker override once stable, create a short ticket with timeline and mitigation.
opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: replication_lag decreased to 1.8s, error rate normalized. Pager resolved at 03:09.
lee: Suggested post-incident followups: add a guard in autoscaler to avoid scaling nodes with >2 replicas in `Applying` state; add a short playbook section for `CrashLoopBackOff` during follower replay.
sana: Noted — filing the followup ticket now and assigning to infra-scaling. Ticket: RD-12345.
alex: Perfect. Handback plan: @sana ping me at 04:05 with final state and I'll take back primary. Anything else? :thumbsup:
sana: All good from my side. Monitoring for 10m.
lee: Standing by.
opsbot: LOG: incident RD-12345 created by sana.
